v004_to_v005_delta: script marker advances from af-hedge-semantic-parity-v004 to v005
adds addIdRef(el, attr, id) which tokenizes whitespace-separated IDREF values, appends the project-owned ID only when absent, and writes a deduplicated relation
form aria-describedby now preserves existing IDREF tokens instead of replacing the entire attribute
service aria-labelledby now preserves existing IDREF tokens instead of replacing the entire attribute
city input aria-describedby now preserves existing IDREF tokens instead of replacing the entire attribute
service role is set to group only when the current role is absent or already group; an unexpected native role is left untouched
review labels/dot suppression, form name, selectors, timing, observer and page guard are otherwise unchanged
source_re_read_findings: review changes remain aria-label on tablist/tabs plus tabindex/aria-hidden on duplicate source dots
form changes remain accessibility attributes/IDs only
why_v005_is_safer_than_v004: The v004 direct setAttribute calls could replace a meaningful aria-describedby/aria-labelledby token if a native/plugin relation exists when apply() reruns. v005 only adds the intended IDREF token and preserves every current token. This is a static monotonic-preservation improvement; it does not prove current MetForm 4.3.0 runtime behavior and therefore does not remove the live conflict/readback gates.

semantic_duplication_risk.finding: Token preservation alone is not sufficient if an existing different IDREF already resolves to semantically equivalent label/help/direct-call text. Appending a second relation can duplicate the computed accessible name/description even though no token is deleted.
preupdate_rule: Resolve every existing form aria-describedby token and compare its referenced text/owner to the intended direct-call paragraph.
Resolve every existing service aria-labelledby token and compare its referenced text/owner to the intended service label.
Resolve every existing city aria-describedby token and compare its referenced text/owner to the intended city help.
If the exact intended element ID is already referenced, addIdRef is a no-op and this aspect is safe.
If a different existing referenced element already supplies the same semantic text/purpose, HOLD v005 rather than create duplicated speech.
If an existing native relation supplies a stronger/different valid semantic owner, HOLD v005 and reconcile ownership rather than append blindly.
semantic_duplication_risk.postupdate_rule: Computed accessible name/description must contain each intended semantic phrase once, with every pre-existing valid native error/help relation still present and resolved. Repeated meaningful description text is a failure even if ID tokens themselves are unique.

metform_source_limit.official_plugin_page: WordPress.org documents installed-equivalent MetForm 4.3.0 dated 2026-08-30 and points to public SVN/source, but the current environment cannot retrieve the 4.3.0 SVN/ZIP source bytes for exact dynamic error-ARIA inspection.
metform_source_limit.claim_not_made: Do not claim that MetForm currently adds or removes aria-describedby during validation from this static evidence alone.
metform_source_limit.consequence: Keep the existing native ARIA/error-state live capture gate.
